title: AIIsOutThere-2026-example
description: A stereo-EEG (sEEG) recording from one patient undergoing clinical intracranial monitoring, containing a clinically confirmed seizure with bilateral tonic-clonic evolution. The recording comprises 100 sEEG contacts across 12 electrodes plus 2 marker inputs, sampled at 256 Hz over about 3.9 hours. Annotations mark the clinical onset and seizure. The data are a BIDS (iEEG-BIDS) conversion of a publicly shared Zenodo deposit.
methods_description: Clinical sEEG recorded as EDF+ at 256 Hz (102 signals, 16-bit, about 3.92 h). The original EDF+ file was copied byte-identically into iEEG-BIDS, with channels, events and electrodes sidecars derived from its header and annotations. No signal processing was applied.
